digest.component_or_area: completion verifier context assembly and prefetch
propositions: Completion verifier receives only fenced ticket context without file contents, causing 84-158 agentic file-discovery requests per run dominated by repeated read_file/search_files round-trips that could be satisfied by declared file_impact

Pre-fetching file_impact contents plus referencing-commit diffs into the completion verifier context, ranked and bounded to 30k tokens, eliminates opening discovery overhead while preserving the full tool surface for agent exploration beyond the prefetch

Close gate (graph=False) prefetches only the closing ticket's own file_impact; standalone deep-review with graph=True prefetches the subtree-union ranked by cross-descendant frequency; both paths drop lowest-ranked files after skeleton-compressing files over 500 lines before hitting the budget
Prefetch is an opt-in parameter on assemble_context (default None) so generic review callers like _review_ticket_impl remain byte-identical; only the completion gate passes a PrefetchSpec

Post-2948 batched recovery successors receive the prefetch via shared assembled ticket_context with prefetch bytes counted against physical_context_ceiling so oversize prefetch is trimmed rather than raising

Trusted anti-anchoring guidance (rely on full bodies directly, re-read only skeleton-marked files) lives in completion_verifier.md static prefix before the volatile marker so it is inherited by successor_system_prompt on both paths
